+
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tags 03S6 and 07A7.

+@[expose] public section

+set_option autoImplicit false

+private theorem transpose_comparison
+    {C D C' D' : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category C'] [Category D']
+    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : L ⊣ R)
+    {L' : C' ⥤ D'} {R' : D' ⥤ C'} (adj' : L' ⊣ R')
+    (Q : C ⥤ C') (Q' : D ⥤ D')
+    (α : Q ⋙ L' ⟶ L ⋙ Q') (β : R ⋙ Q ⟶ Q' ⋙ R')
+    (hε : ∀ Y, L'.map (β.app Y) ≫ adj'.counit.app (Q'.obj Y) =
+      α.app (R.obj Y) ≫ Q'.map (adj.counit.app Y))
+    {M : C} {N : D} {Z : C'} {W : D'}
+    (a : M ⟶ R.obj N) (e : Z ⟶ Q.obj M) (j : Q'.obj N ⟶ W) :
+    L'.map (e ≫ Q.map a ≫ β.app N ≫ R'.map j) ≫ adj'.counit.app W =
+      L'.map e ≫ α.app M ≫ Q'.map (L.map a ≫ adj.counit.app N) ≫ j := by
+  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
+  have hj := adj'.counit.naturality j
+  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at hj
+  rw [hj, reassoc_of% (hε N)]
+  have hn := α.naturality a
+  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map] at hn
+  rw [reassoc_of% hn]
+
+private theorem transpose_comparison_exact
+    {C D C' D' : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category C'] [Category D']
+    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : L ⊣ R)
+    {L' : C' ⥤ D'} {R' : D' ⥤ C'} (adj' : L' ⊣ R')
+    (Q : C ⥤ C') (Q' : D ⥤ D')
+    (α : Q ⋙ L' ⟶ L ⋙ Q') (β : R ⋙ Q ⟶ Q' ⋙ R')
+    (hε : ∀ Y, L'.map (β.app Y) ≫ adj'.counit.app (Q'.obj Y) =
+      α.app (R.obj Y) ≫ Q'.map (adj.counit.app Y))
+    (P : C' ⥤ D') (μ : L' ⟶ P) (φ : Q ⋙ P ⟶ L ⋙ Q')
+    (hα : ∀ M, μ.app (Q.obj M) ≫ φ.app M = α.app M)
+    {M : C} {N : D} {Z : C'} {W : D'}
+    (a : M ⟶ R.obj N) (e : Z ⟶ Q.obj M) (j : Q'.obj N ⟶ W) :
+    L'.map (e ≫ Q.map a ≫ β.app N ≫ R'.map j) ≫ adj'.counit.app W =
+      μ.app Z ≫ P.map e ≫ φ.app M ≫ Q'.map (L.map a ≫ adj.counit.app N) ≫ j := by
+  rw [transpose_comparison adj adj' Q Q' α β hε, ← hα M]
+  simp only [← Category.assoc]
+  rw [μ.naturality]
+
+/-- Transpose a transformation through an adjunction by its component counit.
+Source: Stacks Project Tag 07A7.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection). -/
+@[irreducible]
+noncomputable def graphProjectionTranspose
+    {B C D : Type*} [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
+    {P : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : P ⊣ R)
+    {E : B ⥤ C} {J : B ⥤ D} (a : E ⟶ J ⋙ R) : E ⋙ P ⟶ J :=
+  Functor.whiskerRight a P ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft J adj.counit
+
+/-- The transpose formula, with no structural identity maps left to cancel.
+Source: Stacks Project Tag 07A7.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection). -/
+theorem graphProjectionTranspose_app
+    {B C D : Type*} [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
+    {P : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : P ⊣ R)
+    {E : B ⥤ C} {J : B ⥤ D} (a : E ⟶ J ⋙ R) (M : B) :
+    (graphProjectionTranspose adj a).app M =
+      P.map (a.app M) ≫ adj.counit.app (J.obj M) := by
+  simp only [graphProjectionTranspose, NatTrans.comp_app,
+    Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app]
+
+/-- Descend a projection with its specified source and target factorization isomorphisms.
+Source: Stacks Project Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection). -/
+@[irreducible]
+noncomputable def graphProjectionLocalizationDesc
+    {B B' C C' D D' : Type*}
+    [Category B] [Category B'] [Category C] [Category C'] [Category D] [Category D']
+    (QB : B ⥤ B') (W : MorphismProperty B) [QB.IsLocalization W]
+    {Q : C ⥤ C'} {Q' : D ⥤ D'}
+    {E : B ⥤ C} {ED : B' ⥤ C'} {J : B ⥤ D} {JD : B' ⥤ D'}
+    {P : C ⥤ D} {PD : C' ⥤ D'}
+    (e : QB ⋙ ED ≅ E ⋙ Q) (j : QB ⋙ JD ≅ J ⋙ Q')
+    (p : Q ⋙ PD ≅ P ⋙ Q') (δ : E ⋙ P ⟶ J) : ED ⋙ PD ⟶ JD :=
+  normalizationLocalizationDesc QB W
+    (Functor.whiskerRight e.hom PD ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft E p.hom ≫
+      Functor.whiskerRight δ Q' ≫ j.inv)
+
+/-- Component formula for a descended projection.
+Source: Stacks Project Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection). -/
+theorem graphProjectionLocalizationDesc_app
+    {B B' C C' D D' : Type*}
+    [Category B] [Category B'] [Category C] [Category C'] [Category D] [Category D']
+    (QB : B ⥤ B') (W : MorphismProperty B) [QB.IsLocalization W]
+    {Q : C ⥤ C'} {Q' : D ⥤ D'}
+    {E : B ⥤ C} {ED : B' ⥤ C'} {J : B ⥤ D} {JD : B' ⥤ D'}
+    {P : C ⥤ D} {PD : C' ⥤ D'}
+    (e : QB ⋙ ED ≅ E ⋙ Q) (j : QB ⋙ JD ≅ J ⋙ Q')
+    (p : Q ⋙ PD ≅ P ⋙ Q') (δ : E ⋙ P ⟶ J) (M : B) :
+    (graphProjectionLocalizationDesc QB W e j p δ).app (QB.obj M) =
+      PD.map (e.hom.app M) ≫ p.hom.app (E.obj M) ≫
+        Q'.map (δ.app M) ≫ j.inv.app M := by
+  rw [graphProjectionLocalizationDesc, normalizationLocalizationDesc_app]
+  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app]
+
+/-- The graph projection on homotopy categories, before deriving the proper direct image.
+It applies the sheaf graph map termwise and then the inverse-image/direct-image counit.
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tag 0F4L.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection). -/
+@[irreducible]
+noncomputable def compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
+    (c : Compactification f)
+    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
+        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) :
+    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙
+        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⟶
+      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) :=
+  graphProjectionTranspose
+    ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ))
+    (a.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ≫
+      (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl _) (.up ℤ)).inv)
+
+/-- Descend the termwise graph projection along the homotopy localization.
+This construction uses no total derived direct image.
+Source: Stacks Project Tags 04VG and 0F4L.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection). -/
+@[irreducible]
+noncomputable def compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
+    (c : Compactification f)
+    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
+        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) :
+    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
+        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).mapDerivedCategory ⟶
+      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory :=
+  graphProjectionLocalizationDesc DerivedCategory.Qh
+    (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
+      (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ))
+    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh
+    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh
+    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh
+    (compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy A f c a)
+
+/-- The specified total-derived graph comparison transposes to the termwise graph projection.
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tags 04VG and 07A7.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-derived-projection).
+
+Proof: precompose with the homotopy localization, where the comparison is its defining
+termwise map followed by the right-derived unit. Naturality moves the exact-extension
+comparison past the derived counit. The defining counit equation of the derived adjunction
+replaces the right-derived unit followed by that counit with the homotopy counit. The
+remaining factors are precisely the displayed termwise projection. Full faithfulness of
+precomposition with the localization gives the equality. -/
+theorem compactSupportDerivedComparison_leftDerived_transpose
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
+    (c : Compactification f)
+    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
+        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
+    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
+    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).leftDerivedFunctor.map
+        ((compactSupportDerivedComparison A f c a).app K) ≫
+      (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).counit.app
+        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) =
+      (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).hom.app
+          ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
+        (compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c a).app K := by
+  let E := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance
+  let J := openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i
+  let P := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+  let R := lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+  let adj := upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+  let adjD := derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+  let τ : E.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ P.leftDerivedFunctor ⟶ J.mapDerivedCategory :=
+    Functor.whiskerRight (compactSupportDerivedComparison A f c a) P.leftDerivedFunctor ≫
+      Functor.whiskerLeft J.mapDerivedCategory adjD.counit
+  have h : τ =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft E.mapDerivedCategory P.leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory.hom ≫
+        compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c a := by
+    apply Localization.natTrans_ext DerivedCategory.Qh
+      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
+        (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ))
+    intro M
+    have hε (Y : HomotopyCategory
+        (Sheaf c.Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)) :
+        P.leftDerivedFunctor.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app Y) ≫
+            adjD.counit.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj Y) =
+          P.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app ((R.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj Y) ≫
+            DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((adj.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app Y) :=
+      (adj.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).derivedε_fac_app
+        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
+          (Sheaf c.Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ))
+        P.leftDerivedFunctorCounit R.rightDerivedFunctorUnit Y
+    have hα (Y : HomotopyCategory
+        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)) :
+        P.leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj Y) ≫
+            P.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app Y = P.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app Y :=
+      congr_app P.leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac Y
+    have ht := transpose_comparison_exact (adj.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)) adjD
+      DerivedCategory.Qh DerivedCategory.Qh P.leftDerivedFunctorCounit
+      R.rightDerivedFunctorUnit hε P.mapDerivedCategory
+      P.leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory.hom P.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom hα
+      ((a.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app M ≫
+        (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (F := J) (G := R)
+          (Iso.refl (J ⋙ R)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app M)
+      (E.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app M) (J.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app M)
+    dsimp only [τ, NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app,
+      Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.associator_hom_app, Functor.rightUnitor_hom_app]
+    rw [compactSupportDerivedComparison_app, compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection,
+      graphProjectionLocalizationDesc_app]
+    dsimp only [E, J, P, R, adj, adjD] at ht ⊢
+    simp only [compactSupportComparisonOnHomotopy, compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy,
+      graphProjectionTranspose_app, NatTrans.comp_app,
+      Functor.map_comp, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj, Category.assoc] at ht ⊢
+    exact ht
+  simpa only [τ, E, J, P, adjD, leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory,
+    NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
+    Functor.associator_hom_app, Functor.rightUnitor_hom_app,
+    Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using congr_app h K
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Etale

+private theorem exact_square_normalization
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
+    {Z' Z X' X : Scheme.{u}} {t : Z' ⟶ Z} {p' : Z' ⟶ X'}
+    {p : Z ⟶ X} {g : X' ⟶ X} (sq : CommSq t p' p g)
+    (Y : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
+    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p').leftDerivedFunctor.map
+        ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).inv.app Y) ≫
+      (derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq).hom.app Y ≫
+      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) t).leftDerivedFunctor.map
+        ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).hom.app Y) =
+    (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p').hom.app
+        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategory.obj Y) ≫
+      (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
+        (squareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq)).hom.app Y ≫
+      (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) t).inv.app
+        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).mapDerivedCategory.obj Y) := by
+  simp only [derivedSquareUpperStarIso, squareUpperStarIso, leftDerivedUpperStarComp,
+    Functor.leftDerivedFunctorNatIso, Functor.leftDerivedFunctorCompIso,
+    leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory, Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso,
+    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv, NatTrans.comp_app,
+    Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom,
+    Functor.isoWhiskerRight_hom, Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_inv, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_inv,
+    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_trans, Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_symm,
+    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
+  let ep := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p').leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory
+  let et := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) t).leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory
+  have n₁ := ep.hom.naturality
+    ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory.inv.app Y)
+  have n₂ := et.inv.naturality
+    ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory.hom.app Y)
+  dsimp only [ep, et] at n₁ n₂
+  rw [reassoc_of% n₁, ← n₂, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
+  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
+  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
+  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]

+set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
+-- Normalizing these comparison maps involves several dependent scheme categories.
+/-- The termwise graph projections commute with the sum and open-extension exchanges.
+Only exact functors on complexes occur in this equation; there is no total derived
+proper direct image in either projection.
+Source: Stacks Project Tags 03S6, 0F4L, 07A7, 0E46 and 0E47.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-graph-projection-base-change).
+
+Proof: pull the clopen graph decomposition to the cartesian square. On the graph component,
+both composites keep the same section of the corresponding etale lift; on the complement,
+both are zero. The disjoint-cover sheaf axiom therefore gives equality of the sheaf
+projections. The sum and open-extension exchanges are the left-adjoint comparisons of
+the restriction/direct-image square; mate pasting identifies the two composition
+comparisons. Apply this sheaf identity degreewise and descend through the homotopy
+localization. The displayed exact-functor comparison maps insert the canonical
+identifications of left-derived inverse image with termwise inverse image. The argument
+uses no finiteness, nonempty-fibre, Noetherian or boundedness hypothesis. -/
+theorem compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection_baseChange
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
+    {U X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] [IsSeparated f]
+    (c : Compactification f) (g : X' ⟶ X)
+    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
+    let c' := c.ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip
+    let h := pullback.snd g f
+    let t := pullback.fst c.g g
+    let E := (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
+    let E' := (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst g f)
+      inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
+    let J' := (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.i).mapDerivedCategory
+    let H := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).mapDerivedCategory
+    let P' := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g).leftDerivedFunctor
+    P'.map ((exactEtaleSumExchange A f g).hom.app K) ≫
+        (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g).hom.app
+          (E'.obj (H.obj K)) ≫
+        (compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A (pullback.fst g f) c'
+          (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A (pullback.fst g f) c')).app (H.obj K) =
+      P'.map ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
+          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).inv.app (E.obj K)) ≫
+        (derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
+          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g g).toCommSq).hom.app (E.obj K) ≫
+        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) t).leftDerivedFunctor.map
+          ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
+              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).hom.app (E.obj K) ≫
+            (compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c
+              (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c)).app K) ≫
+        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
+          (c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip)).inv.app K ≫
+        J'.map ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
+          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).hom.app K) := by
+  let c' := c.ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip
+  let h := pullback.snd g f
+  let t := pullback.fst c.g g
+  let E := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance
+  let E' := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst g f) inferInstance
+  let P := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+  let P' := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g
+  let J := openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i
+  let J' := openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.i
+  let H := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h
+  let G := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g

+/-!
+# The sheaf projection and its exact derived image
+
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tags 0F4L and 04VG.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false

+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits

+attribute [local irreducible] upperStar lowerStar etaleLowerShriek openImmersionLowerShriek

+/-- The sheaf projection adjoint to a compactification comparison.
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tag 0F4L.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-termwise-projection). -/
+noncomputable def compactSupportGraphSheafProjection
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
+    (c : Compactification f)
+    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
+        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) :
+    etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⋙
+        upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i :=
+  Functor.whiskerRight a (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) ≫
+    Functor.whiskerLeft (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i)
+      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).counit
+
+private theorem transpose_on_homotopy
+    {B C D : Type*} [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
+    [Abelian B] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
+    (E : B ⥤ C) (J : B ⥤ D) (P : C ⥤ D) (R : D ⥤ C)
+    [E.Additive] [J.Additive] [P.Additive] [R.Additive] (adj : P ⊣ R)
+    (a : E ⟶ J ⋙ R) (δ : E ⋙ P ⟶ J)
+    (hδ : ∀ M, P.map (a.app M) ≫ adj.counit.app (J.obj M) = δ.app M)
+    (K : HomotopyCategory B (.up ℤ)) :
+    (P.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map
+        ((a.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K ≫
+          (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl (J ⋙ R)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
+        (adj.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app
+          ((J.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) =
+      (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl (E ⋙ P)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
+        (δ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K := by
+  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective K
+  change _ ≫ (adj.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app
+    ((HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).obj
+      ((J.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)) = _
+  rw [Adjunction.mapHomotopyCategory_counit_app_quotient]
+  change (HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).map _ ≫
+      (HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).map _ =
+    (HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).map _ ≫
+      (HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).map _
+  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
+  congr 1
+  ext n
+  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_map_f,
+    NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex_app_f, Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso_hom_app_f,
+    Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso_inv_app_f,
+    Adjunction.mapHomologicalComplex_counit_app_f, Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_inv,
+    NatTrans.id_app, Functor.map_comp]
+  change (P.map (a.app (K.X n)) ≫ P.map (𝟙 (R.obj (J.obj (K.X n))))) ≫
+    adj.counit.app (J.obj (K.X n)) = 𝟙 (P.obj (E.obj (K.X n))) ≫ δ.app (K.X n)
+  erw [P.map_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
+  exact hδ (K.X n)
+
+/-- The homotopy projection is the termwise image of the sheaf projection.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 0F4L.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-termwise-projection).
+
+Proof: represent the homotopy object by a complex. The induced adjunction counit and
+all composition comparisons are degreewise the sheaf counit and identity comparisons.
+Each component is therefore the defining sheaf transpose. -/
+theorem compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy_termwise
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
+    (c : Compactification f)
+    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
+        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
+    (K : HomotopyCategory (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)) :
+    (compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy A f c a).app K =
+      (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso
+        (Iso.refl (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⋙
+          upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
+        ((compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A f c a).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K := by
+  have h := transpose_on_homotopy
+    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance)
+    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i)
+    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
+    (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
+    a (compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A f c a) (fun M ↦ by
+      simp only [compactSupportGraphSheafProjection, NatTrans.comp_app,
+        Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
+        Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj]) K
+  simpa only [compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy, graphProjectionTranspose_app,
+    NatTrans.comp_app,
+    Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.associator_hom_app,
+    Functor.rightUnitor_hom_app, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj,
+    Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using h
+
+/-- The descended graph projection is the image of its sheaf projection.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 04VG and 0F4L.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-termwise-projection).
+
+Proof: precompose with the homotopy localization and use the defining factorization
+of each exact derived functor. The composition comparison cancels the two source
+factorizations, and the preceding termwise transpose identity identifies the remaining
+map. Localization full faithfulness gives the result. -/
+theorem compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection_termwise
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
+    (c : Compactification f)
+    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
+      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
+        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) :
+    compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c a =
+      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
+        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance)
+        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)).inv ≫
+      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans (compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A f c a) := by
+  let E := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance
+  let P := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+  let J := openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i
+  apply Localization.natTrans_ext DerivedCategory.Qh
+    (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ))
+  intro K
+  rw [← cancel_epi ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso E P).hom.app
+    (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K)), ← cancel_mono (J.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K)]
+  dsimp only [E, P, J]
+  rw [compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection, graphProjectionLocalizationDesc_app]
+  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.comp_obj, Category.assoc]
+  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_fac,
+    Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
+  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Category.comp_id]
+  rw [compactSupportGraphProjectionOnHomotopy_termwise,
+    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_factorsh_assoc]
+  rw [Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso_refl_hom_app]
+  simp only [Category.id_comp]
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Etale

+/-!
+# The sheaf graph projection under base change
+
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tags 03S6, 0F4L, 0E46 and 0E47.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u

+
+/-- Base change preserves the clopen-graph projection, as a transformation of sheaves.
+There are no complexes, localization functors or total derived direct images in this identity.
+Source: SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; Stacks Project Tags 03S6, 0F4L, 0E46 and 0E47.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-compact-support-graph-sheaf-base-change).
+
+Proof: transpose the specified graph map back under inverse image/direct image.
+The triangle identities cancel its inserted unit and counit, giving the original etale
+sum base-change comparison, clopen graph projection and graph composition comparison.
+Write these over the fiber products of the compactification with its etale source.
+The graph is a clopen section of the second projection. Pulling the graph
+and its complementary open subset through the cartesian square gives the graph and complement
+for the pulled-back compactification. The graph projection is the identity on the graph
+component and zero on the complement; its base change has the same two restrictions. The
+sheaf axiom for this disjoint open cover equates them. The etale sum exchange is normalized
+by the inverse conjugate of the inverse-image/direct-image exchange; the open-extension
+exchange and the graph composition comparison are likewise normalized by their displayed
+adjunctions. Horizontal and vertical mate pasting therefore identify the comparison maps
+in the two rectangles with the specified sum, pullback-square and open-extension maps.
+Composing the equal graph projections with those comparisons proves the displayed equation.
+Empty fibers and the zero ring give the same identity and require no extra assumption. -/
+theorem compactSupportGraphSheafProjection_baseChange
+    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
+    {U X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] [IsSeparated f]
+    (c : Compactification f) (g : X' ⟶ X) :
+    let c' := c.ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip
+    let E := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance
+    let H := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd g f)
+    let E' := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst g f) inferInstance
+    let P := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
+    let P' := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g
+    let T := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst c.g g)
+    let δ := compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A f c (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c)
+    let δ' := compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A (pullback.fst g f) c'
+      (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A (pullback.fst g f) c')
+    letI := isIso_etaleLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A g f
+    let σ := (asIso (etaleLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A g f)).symm
+    Functor.whiskerRight σ.hom P' ≫ (Functor.associator H E' P').hom ≫
+        Functor.whiskerLeft H δ' ≫
+        openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
+          (c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip).toCommSq =
+      (Functor.associator E (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g) P').hom ≫
+        Functor.whiskerLeft E
+          (squareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
+            (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g g).toCommSq).hom ≫
+        (Functor.associator E P T).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight δ T := by sorry
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Etale

+/-!
+# Natural transformations of exact functors on unbounded derived categories
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 04VG, localization universal property.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits
+
+namespace CategoryTheory.Functor
+
+variable {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
+  [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [Abelian E]
+  [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasDerivedCategory E]
+  {F F' F'' : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [F'.Additive] [F''.Additive]
+  [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
+  [PreservesFiniteLimits F'] [PreservesFiniteColimits F']

+/-- Descend a termwise natural transformation of exact functors through localization.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations). -/
+noncomputable def mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans (τ : F ⟶ F') :
+    F.mapDerivedCategory ⟶ F'.mapDerivedCategory :=
+  Localization.liftNatTrans DerivedCategory.Qh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))
+    (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
+    (F'.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
+    F.mapDerivedCategory F'.mapDerivedCategory
+    (Functor.whiskerRight (τ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)) DerivedCategory.Qh)
+
+/-- The value of the descended transformation on a homotopy representative.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations). -/
+@[reassoc]
+theorem mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_fac (τ : F ⟶ F') (K : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ)) :
+    (mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans τ).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) ≫
+        F'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K =
+      F.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K ≫
+        DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((τ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K) := by
+  simp only [mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans, Localization.liftNatTrans_app,
+    Functor.whiskerRight_app, Category.assoc]
+  change F.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K ≫
+      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((τ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K) ≫
+      F'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app K ≫
+      F'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K = _
+  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Functor.comp_obj, Category.comp_id]
+
+/-- Descent preserves composition.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations). -/
+theorem mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_comp (τ : F ⟶ F') (υ : F' ⟶ F'') :
+    mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans (τ ≫ υ) =
+      mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans τ ≫ mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans υ := by
+  apply Localization.natTrans_ext DerivedCategory.Qh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))
+  intro K
+  rw [← cancel_mono (F''.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K)]
+  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Category.assoc, mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_fac,
+    mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_fac_assoc, NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory_comp,
+    Functor.map_comp]
+
+/-- On an isomorphism this is the existing exact-functor comparison.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations). -/
+theorem mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_iso (e : F ≅ F') :
+    mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans e.hom = (mapDerivedCategoryNatIso e).hom := by
+  apply Localization.natTrans_ext DerivedCategory.Qh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))
+  intro K
+  rw [← cancel_mono (F'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K),
+    mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_fac, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fach]
+
+omit [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasDerivedCategory E]
+  [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
+  [PreservesFiniteLimits F'] [PreservesFiniteColimits F'] in
+private theorem mapHomotopyCategory_whiskerRight (τ : F ⟶ F') (G : D ⥤ E)
+    [G.Additive] (K : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ)) :
+    ((Functor.whiskerRight τ G).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K =
+      (G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map ((τ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K) := by
+  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective K
+  rfl
+
+omit [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasDerivedCategory E]
+  [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
+  [PreservesFiniteLimits F'] [PreservesFiniteColimits F'] in
+private theorem mapHomotopyCategory_whiskerLeft (G : E ⥤ C) [G.Additive]
+    (τ : F ⟶ F') (K : HomotopyCategory E (.up ℤ)) :
+    ((Functor.whiskerLeft G τ).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K =
+      (τ.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app ((G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) := by
+  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective K
+  rfl
+
+attribute [local instance] comp_preservesFiniteLimits comp_preservesFiniteColimits
+
+/-- Descent commutes with postcomposition, through the canonical composition comparisons.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 04VG.
+(blueprint: lem-a2-exact-derived-natural-transformations). -/
+theorem mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_whiskerRight (τ : F ⟶ F') (G : D ⥤ E)
+    [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G] :
+    mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans (Functor.whiskerRight τ G) ≫
